250g unsalted butter, at room temperature

1 1⁄2 cups whole milk
1 cup plus 2 tbsp sugar

Instructions:

Bring the milk to a boil in a small saucepan.  Reduce the heat, and add the sugar, whisking to dissolve.  Simmer for 2 minutes, then turn off the heat.  Add the butter and mix well.  Take the pan off the heat and let the butter cool.

In a small bowl, whisk together the pepper and  2 tbsp of the sugar.  Roll the dough on a lightly floured surface until roughly 20 cm by 15 cm.  Cut out individual balls and roll out each ball into a flat disk.  Cut out discs using a 4cm square cookie cutter.  Set them aside.
Place two  tablespoons of the butter and sugar in the centre of a large, flat surface.  Roll each disk of dough into a ball and place it on the butter-soaked surface.  Use a fork to prick the surface of the dough and turn it over to the other side.  Sprinkle half of the pepper-sugar mixture on top.  Brush the surface, and flatten with a fork.  Roll up the dough into a tight cylinder, and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Repeat with the remaining dough, butter and sugar, and remaining 2 tbsp of sugar.
